About this item

  • Flagship Performance Chipset: Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra (TSMC 4nm process, up to 3.4GHz) and an advanced REDMI 3D Ice-Loop Cooling Technology. It runs seamlessly on the next-gen Xiaomi HyperOS 3 with up to 12GB LPDDR5X RAM (Expandable up to 24GB) and 256GB UFS 4.1 storage
  • Revolutionary Battery & Charging: Features a massive 7540mAh Silicon-Carbon battery with 100W Xiaomi Hypercharge and 27W wired reverse charging to power other devices on the go
  • Stunning Sunlight Display: A compact 16.75cm (6.59) ultra-narrow bezel 1.5K AMOLED display with a fluid 120Hz refresh rate, a blinding 3500 nits peak brightness, and Xiaomi Premium Eye Protection（ TUV Eye-protection Certified). One of the only displays in the segment to house a 12-bit display supporting 68Bn+ Colours
  • Sony Pro Camera: Capture perfection with the 50MP Sony large-aperture main camera (IMX882, f/1.5, OIS), an 8MP ultra-wide lens, and a 20MP HD Selfie shooter. TurboSnap Burst mode - up to 100 pictures captured in 4.4s
  • Ultimate Durability: Built to withstand the elements with advanced IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K water and dust resistance. Aero-space Grade Metal Frame with Corning️ Gorilla️ Glass 7i Protection

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we do not use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things such as how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Learn more about how customer reviews work on Amazon

    Customers say

    Customers praise the phone's performance, particularly its gaming speed, and appreciate its display, with one highlighting its stunning 120Hz AMOLED display. The phone's design receives positive feedback for its premium look, and customers like its quality, with one noting it's the best in its segment.       Here is my honest rating after setting it up:

      Appearance (10/10): Looks and feels premium. It does get a little warm, but that’s just the metal frame and glass back doing their job to dissipate heat.

      Display (10/10): Super sharp, bright, and smooth.

      Performance (10/10): Handles everything easily with zero lag.

      Camera (8/10): Really good, honestly exceeded my expectations. Don't skip this phone because of what is written on paper specifications.

      Software & Haptics (10/10): The UI is clean, and the vibration/haptics are perfectly tuned with the system animations.

      Battery & Charging (8/10): Battery backup could be a little better (hopefully updates improve it). But charging is excellent—you get a standard mode to keep the phone cool, and a 100W max speed mode that charges insanely fast but warms it up a bit.

      Audio & Network(10/10): Speakers with Dolby Atmos sound great. Seamless 5G (has all Indian bands), solid Wi-Fi, and clear call quality.

      Biometrics(7/10): The fingerprint scanner could be a tiny bit faster, but the unlock animations look fantastic.

      Overall, a solid flagship killer!

      Powerful Performance, Great Charging, but Disappointing Battery Life & some heating issues
      Reviewed in India on 26 October 2026
      Colour: Asphalt BlackSize: 8GB+256GB
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      ## Redmi Turbo 5 (8GB RAM + 256GB Storage) — My Honest Review

      **Design:** The black color doesn't look particularly attractive to me. The white variant looks much more premium.

      **Heating:** Heating occurs randomly, with temperatures reaching a maximum of around 46°C. Normally, the temperature stays between 28°C and 40°C.

      **Gaming Performance:** Gaming performance is good, with no noticeable lag. FPS remains quite stable, averaging around 55–60 FPS in 60 FPS gameplay.

      **Camera:**

      - **Rear camera:** Good, but not exceptionally impressive.

      - **Front camera:** Good during the day, but not that good at night.

      **Video Stabilization:** Good overall.

      **Battery Life:** Very poor, in my experience. The 7,000 mAh battery doesn't feel like a 7,000 mAh battery; it feels more like a 4,000 mAh battery. With 4–6 hours of daily usage, including gaming and multimedia consumption, I need to charge the phone every day.

      **Charging Speed:** Charging speed is good. It takes around 40 minutes to charge the phone fully, which is convenient.

      **Haptics:** The haptic feedback is nice and feels satisfying during everyday use.

      **Processor and Value for Money:** The biggest advantage is the Dimensity 8500-Ultra processor. Getting this level of performance in this price range is definitely a plus point.

      ### Final Verdict

      The Redmi Turbo 5 offers good gaming performance, a powerful processor, fast charging, and satisfying haptics. The cameras and video stabilization are decent, but the battery backup is disappointing, and heating can occur randomly. The black color also doesn't look as premium as the white variant, in my opinion.

      Overall, it's a good option for performance-focused users, but the battery life could be much better.
